action.rationale: Only commit_ready moves are a2a3 and c6c7. c6c7 has the deepest exact evidence (score -1206 at depth 3) and verified no mate-in-one with tactical_refutation not_found. a2a3 is shallower (-1114 at depth 2) and the shared-depth comparison at depth 2 favors c6c7 (-965 vs -1114). No forced mate or refutation exists for c6c7; the pawn on c7 restricts Black's rook and knight, and White's king has no immediate checking mate threat. Retain uncertainty on quiet threats, but c6c7 is the strongest verified choice.
